svg.aria-label: Contour lines of the loss L = (2w + b − 6)² over the parameters w and b. The lines are parallel, and the loss is zero along the line 2w + b = 6. From the start (1, 0), where L = 16, the step −η times the gradient crosses the lines at a right angle. With η = 0.1 it lands at (2.6, 0.8) on the zero-loss line; with η = 0.25 it continues past the valley to (5, 2), where L = 36.
svg.text: Every point of the line 2w + b = 6 predicts 6,
so the loss is zero along it. The step crosses
the lines at a right angle; η sets its length.
